quest.title: Delicious Riddle
quest.description: The resourceful Araesha has prepared "delicious" riddles for Festival Utsava.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Good Nara! Araesha's riddles are tasty!

talks.objective: Have a crack at Araesha's riddle

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: This one is easy! There are more delicious riddles to follow, so come again.

talks.objective: Take a stab at Araesha's second riddle

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: This is easy too. Aranara all know it. Good Nara is Aranara's friend and naturally knows it. Let me give you one more riddle.

talks.objective: Test your wit with Araesha's third riddle

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Good Nara! All correct! Good Nara is a clever Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Clever Nara! Smarter than Araja! Would Nara be willing to be Araesha's friend?

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Yes! Flower for you. Araesha will think of more good riddles. Come play with Araesha again, friend!

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Nara friend! Arama has told many stories of you. You are a Nara full of courage and wisdom. Come challenge Araesha's riddles!

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Oh... Don't forget, Nara friend. Araesha will wait here.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Round and red and good to eat, it hangs on a tree, moist and sweet.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: It exists in dreams and no other place, a must for Festival Utsava space.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: This one is difficult. Even Araja wouldn't know it! There are stars in the sky, and it is on the land. Stars cannot see the sun, and it doesn't love the sun either.

dialogues.speaker: Araesha
dialogues.text: Hmm, wrong answer. Please think again, good Nara.
